color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modification. Light register confirmed (pageBackground luminance: 242).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Letter spacing injection at 0.06em for all heading-role elements. All proprietary fonts replaced: Brilliant Cut → Cormorant Garamond (headings, editorial), Fancy Cut / Arial → Jost (body, nav, buttons). Both available via Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Duration scaling (slower) ×1.8. Primary durations: 0.1s→0.18s, 0.15s→0.27s, 0.2s→0.36s, 0.5s→0.9s, 1.4s→2.52s, 0.3s→0.54s, 0.6s→1.08s. Creates languid, deliberate pacing throughout.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Container max-width expanded from 400px to 1320px (editorial standard). Added 12-column grid, responsive breakpoints at 375px/768px/1024px/1440px. Transforms a narrow app-frame layout into an immersive editorial grid.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Global scale factor ×1.35 applied. Tooltip margin 30px→41px, p padding 10px→14px, li margin 10px→14px. Added full spacing scale (xs–3xl), section padding 96px, hero padding 128px, button padding expanded.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist A: Hover transition speed made more languid. All link/nav/button hover transition durations increased from 0.3s to 0.45s (+0.15s). Nav hover opacity set to 0.75. No color values changed.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Letter spacing on nav links added at 0.08em (intensity 3). Background transition duration updated to 0.45s to match languid motion system. FontFamily set to Jost to reference assembled type system. Logo position: left.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift applied to the Spatial System paragraph — added tactile detail about weight, air, and surface resistance to ground the spatial tokens in physical sensation. New concept_by_video.md generated with 3 video placements (hero, studio/events, product detail).
